children.content: KA Brand Downward Exploration Analysis Report
茶饮业务组品牌下探数据分析报告

This report provides a comprehensive analysis of 19 tea and coffee brands within the KA brand downward exploration program, examining their January 2025 performance across key metrics including GMV, advertising efficiency, store operations, and growth trends.

children.content: The tea and coffee sector represents a massive market with 19 brands operating 147,234 stores nationwide. January 2025 saw total GMV of ¥1.04B across 122.3M orders, with an average order value of ¥8.48.
